paragraphs: EnSight Technologies sells parking technology built around occupancy counting, parking guidance, vehicle identification, and paid parker management. The company's argument is that intelligent parking guidance technology should be available to everyday parking providers, not only to the largest operators. The about page traces the product to years of experience in developing optical and machine vision technologies.

Counting cars is the foundation, with a stated accuracy guarantee of greater than 99%. Signage then gives drivers customizable guidance so they can make smart parking decisions. Cameras or LED parking guidance sensors monitor specialty spaces. A license plate recognition module identifies who is parking and monitors dwell time. A smart API allows data sharing with third parties.

The clients page groups the work by setting, among them stadiums and event centers. Campus parking is another, pitched as a clever, cost-effective guidance system. The company claims 20+ years of experience developing vision-based technology. Its team page lists a co-founder and VP of product innovation among the leadership.

quote.text: We believe less is more, providing parkers with enough information to make intelligent parking decisions.
